title: previewHistoryPrune
responsibility: Builds and renders a report-only verification-cache retention inventory, marking every matching record as protected because durable deletion proof is unavailable.

inputs.name: previewHistoryPrune.root
inputs.description: Pass the repository root; the function resolves it for the verification-cache scan and Git HEAD lookup.

inputs.name: previewHistoryPrune.keepLast
inputs.description: Number of newest valid cache records excluded from age matches. Must be a safe integer from 0 through 100000.

inputs.name: previewHistoryPrune.olderThanDays
inputs.description: Age cutoff in whole days before now. Must be a safe integer from 1 through 36500, and a record matches only when it is older than the cutoff and outside keep-last.

inputs.name: previewHistoryPrune.now
inputs.description: Date used to compute the cutoff by subtracting olderThanDays in milliseconds. Defaults to new Date() when omitted.

inputs.name: renderPrune.result
inputs.description: Report-only inventory returned by previewHistoryPrune, including entries, the cutoff, the resolved HEAD when available, and scan problems.

protectionReasons: local record may still be needed for attachment or concurrent use; no durable deletion proof or use lock is checked

outputs.name: previewHistoryPrune
outputs.description: Resolves to a report-only inventory with sorted entries, the cutoff, and scan problems; matching rows remain protected and no cache files are changed. The result has applySupported false, and headCommit is omitted when Git HEAD cannot be resolved.

protectionReasons: local record may still be needed for attachment or concurrent use; no durable deletion proof or use lock is checked

outputs.name: renderPrune
outputs.description: Human-readable report with a count of retention matches, each matching protected entry, and any scan problems.
examples:
Report-only inventory: 1 records match keep-last 0 and older-than 30 days.
No files were changed. Deletion is not supported; no --apply mode exists.
  .harness/verification-evidence/records/2026-10-01T09-00-00.000Z.json (1842 bytes): protected — local record may still be needed for attachment or concurrent use; no durable deletion proof or use lock is checked

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Invalid keep-last values throw Error('--keep-last must be a whole number between 0 and 100000.'); invalid age values throw Error('--older-than must be between 1 and 36500 whole days.'). Git lookup or cache scanning may also reject if an underlying operation fails.
